name: Folder-TS-TW
title: Interactive File Folder
blurb: Interactive folder icon expands to reveal papers with hover offset.
description: An interactive folder component that opens/closes on click to reveal stacked paper items inside (max 3). Papers respond to mouse movement with parallax-like offset when folder is open.
use_when: Navigation, file explorers, or playful UI elements showcasing folder/file interaction metaphors.
avoid_when: When actual file system functionality is needed; this is purely decorative and visual.
a11y: Click to expand/collapse; no keyboard interaction or focus management; mouse movement-based hover offsets.
